text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Finally, the spring Tenno Sho is here.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Good luck, McQueen! Get that third<n>title!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You can do it! Smash that record!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen has already won<n>the spring
Tenno Sho twice.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That's why beating her today would<n>be a miracle
that nobody expects. So...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No matter how far ahead of me she<n>gets, I won't
give up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Were you not the one to invite us<n>here?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: B-but you guys are all too fast! Wait<n>uuup!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Good luck out there, Rice! We'll be<n>cheering you on
from the stands!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I'm looking forward to seeing you<n>become a blue
rose.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My objective here is to observe your<n>victory, not
your defeat.
